definitions.explanation: The person in charge of a group or organization. Can refer to a workplace superior, the head of a criminal gang, or the final enemy in a video game.

examples.japanese: ボス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧。
⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ラスボス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{倒|たお}せない→倒す：01954_taosu⟧。
examples.english: I just can't beat the final boss of the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ボス⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He is known as the boss-like figure in this industry.

notes:
USAGE:
ボス is used across several contexts: casual reference to a workplace boss (more informal than ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧), the leader of a criminal organization (⟦{組|くみ}→組：02668_kumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ボス), and especially common in gaming (ボスキャラ, ラスボス).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ラスボス: final boss (⟦ラスト→ラスト：30487_rasuto⟧ + ボス)
- ボスキャラ: boss character (in games)
- ボス⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧: boss fight
- ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ボス: hidden/secret boss

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧ is the standard word for one's workplace superior. ボス is more informal and can sound dramatic or humorous when used for everyday work relationships.
